resources.string:
Unofficial SoftEther VPN reads network packets to route them according to your settings, including while the app is in the background. TUN uses Android’s VpnService. TAP uses a Root-managed Ethernet interface.

Standard app-managed connections establish a TLS session with the SoftEther server you configure. That server receives the forwarded traffic and may have its own privacy practices. Advanced TAP accounts can use different transport and encryption settings.

TAP NAT traversal and optional UDP acceleration may send connection metadata, such as IP addresses and ports, to SoftEther’s discovery service. The app does not send a separate copy of your VPN traffic to the developer.

Unofficial SoftEther VPN reads the installed app list, including app names, package names and Android app UIDs, to show the app routing list and apply routing rules on this device. TAP may also read the list while applying address rules or restoring routes.\n\nThe app uses the list on this device and does not send it to the VPN server or developer. Diagnostic logs may include package names and can be exported by you.

Review and accept the disclosures before starting the VPN.

VPN traffic is sent to the server you configure. VPN credentials, trusted certificates and routing preferences are stored in the app’s private storage. The installed app list is used to apply routing rules on this device. You can turn on diagnostic collection on the Logs screen and export a copy manually. Collected events stay in memory while the app process runs. You can remove saved profiles, clear collected logs, or clear app data in Android Settings.
